implementation_plan.scope: Complete command_router.gleam with real handlers and comprehensive tests
implementation_plan.approach: TDD - write tests first, then implement handlers, then integrate CLI

phase_4_red: Write parse_request tests (5 cases: valid, missing command, invalid JSON, optional id, optional args)
Write route_request tests (4 cases: quality, coverage, gaps, unknown)
Write error_response tests (4 cases: each RouterError variant)
Write process_single_request tests (3 cases: success, parse error, handler error)
Write handler tests expecting real implementations (will fail)
Run gleam test - expect handler tests to fail with stub messages
phase_5_green: Add helper execute_with_spec for common pattern
Run gleam test - all tests should pass
Test CLI integration manually: echo '{"command":"quality","args":{"spec_path":"test.cue"}}' | intent jsonl

files_to_modify.description: Replace stub handlers with real implementations

integration_strategy.behavior: Read stdin line by line, process each as JSONL command, output JSONL responses

risks.risk: Analyzer functions may not have JSON output variants
risks.mitigation: Check function signatures first, wrap if needed

risks.risk: stdin reading in Gleam may be complex
risks.mitigation: Use FFI if needed, or process line-by-line with io.read_line

risks.risk: Integration tests harder without real spec files
risks.mitigation: Use examples/ directory specs for manual testing
